page_title: MAL 0-1 BET | Mallorca v Betis 27/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) earns the yellow card.
90+3' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
90+2' 14:8 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
90+2' Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) brings his opponent down. Javier Iglesias Villanueva has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Rodri (Betis) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Predrag Rajkovic intercepts the ball.
89' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Mallorca will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

88' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
87' A cross into the box from Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) is cleared.
86' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Rui Silva, who smothers the ball.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luiz Henrique trots off the pitch and is replaced by Juan Cruz (Betis).
82' A lofted pass to the edge of the six-yard box is won in the air by Abdon Prats (Mallorca), but his tame header goes well wide of the left post.
81' An attempted cross from Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) is cleared.
79' Toni Lato comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jaume Costa (Mallorca).
79' Javier Aguirre has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Javier Llabres (Mallorca) replacing Manu Morlanes.
79' Rui Silva (Betis) gets a yellow card.
78' Toni Lato (Mallorca) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
78' Sergi Altimira (Betis) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
76' The foul by Toni Lato (Mallorca) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Javier Iglesias Villanueva.
75' Betis couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Predrag Rajkovic (Mallorca) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
74' The attendance for today's match is 20051.
74' Betis have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
72' The game is interrupted now, Luiz Henrique (Betis) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
71' A player from Mallorca commits a rough challenge. Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
68' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) sends a wild header high over the bar.
68' Mallorca earn a corner.
67' The free kick is taken by Sergi Darder (Mallorca), but ball is cleared.
66' Substitution. Willian Jose (Betis) on for Nabil Fekir.
66' Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle after Nabil Fekir (Betis) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
65' Isco (Betis) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
64' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.

63' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
62' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
61' Rodri (Betis) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
58' A substitution has been made. Cyle Larin is replaced by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca).
58' Javier Aguirre has decided to substitute Martin Valjent and he is replaced by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca).
57' Rodri (Betis) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
57' A quickly taken corner by Betis.
56' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
54' Ricardo Visus (Betis) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle for a foul.
50' The Mallorca players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' Half-time substitution. Assane Diao (Betis) will not participate anymore and Rodri is coming on.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Manuel Pellegrini gives a chance to Ricardo Visus and German Pezzella (Betis) is off.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+9' Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Toni Lato (Mallorca) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.

45+1' 0 - 1 What a hit that is! Sergi Altimira (Betis) displays his shooting ability as he slams the ball goalwards from distance. His brilliant effort bounces in off the left post, leaving the goalkeeper beaten.
45+1' Nabil Fekir (Betis) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
45+1' 7 additional min. will be played.
44' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
42' Javier Iglesias Villanueva interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Sergi Altimira (Betis).
42' Sergi Altimira (Betis) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
41' German Pezzella (Betis) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
38' German Pezzella (Betis) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
37' The ball goes out of play. Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.
37' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
36' Samu Costa is substituted due to injury. Javier Aguirre gives a chance to Omar Mascarell (Mallorca).
36' Samu Costa (Mallorca) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' Isco (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but Predrag Rajkovic comes off his line to gather the ball.
34' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Mallorca for a penalty. Play continues.
33' Samu Costa (Mallorca) is able to continue to play.
33' Nabil Fekir (Betis) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
32' Samu Costa (Mallorca) is asking for medical treatment, but he will have to leave the pitch in order to receive help from the physio.
30' Samu Costa (Mallorca) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
28' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle for a foul.
27' German Pezzella (Betis) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
27' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
25' The game is interrupted now, German Pezzella (Betis) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
25' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
22' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles over the bar.
20' Mallorca are ruled offside.
20' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Mallorca.
17' Isco (Betis) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
15' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) latches on to a superb cross inside the box but only hits the crossbar with a fine header. What a chance!
14' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.
13' Sergi Altimira (Betis) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Betis.
13' Betis get a corner.
12' Samu Costa (Mallorca) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
10' Johnny (Betis) towers above the defence but fails to trouble the keeper, heading the corner kick well wide of the left post from close range.
10' The ball is out of play and Betis manage to earn a corner.
10' Luiz Henrique (Betis) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Predrag Rajkovic easily deals with the threat.
9' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Betis.
6' Mallorca fail to score from a corner as Rui Silva (Betis) leaps to collect the ball.
6' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Cyle Larin (Mallorca) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
5' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.
4' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. Mallorca win a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Mallorca will take the kick-off.
